rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Floribunda.
Registration name: BARash
rows.Bloom: Orange or orange-red. Moderate fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), button-eye bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Armed with thorns / prickles, bushy.

Height: 28" to 35" (70 to 90cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Rose Barni says the color of the blooms starts out as a brilliant coral orange that ages to vermilion-red...
No. 081 in the 1999 Monza Competition. (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
